item.description:
Waypoint is curating and commenting on third-party reporting. Original publisher: Phys.org.
Summary: In northeastern North America, a stretch of mountains runs 500 miles (800 kilometers) from the Adirondacks in New York to the Gaspé Peninsula in eastern Quebec.
